campo.campo:
case when q166_limite_inicial = 0 and q166_limite_final = 100 then
( select to_jsonb(array_agg(x)) from ( select q160_descricao as descricao, (((($faturamento * q164_aliquotatotal / 100) - q164_valordeducao) / $faturamento * 100) * (q165_aliquotaimposto) / 100) as valor from issgsanexosfaixasimpostosvalores inner join issgscadimpostos on q160_sequencial = q165_issgscadimpostos where q165_issgsanexosfaixasimpostoslimites = q166_sequencial ) as x )
else
( select to_jsonb(array_agg(x)) from (select q160_descricao as descricao, case when q160_sequencial = 6 then case when (((($faturamento * q164_aliquotatotal / 100) - q164_valordeducao) / $faturamento) * 100) > 14.92537 and q157_sequencial = 1 then 5 else case when (((($faturamento * q164_aliquotatotal / 100) - q164_valordeducao) / $faturamento) * 100) > 12.5 and q157_sequencial = 2 then 5 else ((($faturamento * q164_aliquotatotal / 100) - q164_valordeducao) / $faturamento * (q165_aliquotaimposto / 100)) * 100 end end else (((($faturamento * q164_aliquotatotal / 100) - q164_valordeducao) / $faturamento * 100) - 5) * (q165_aliquotaimposto) / 100 end as valor from issgsanexosfaixasimpostosvalores inner join issgscadimpostos on q160_sequencial = q165_issgscadimpostos where q165_issgsanexosfaixasimpostoslimites = q166_sequencial ) as x )
end

campo.campo:
case when q166_limite_inicial = 0 and q166_limite_final = 100 then
( select sum( ( ( ( $faturamento * q164_aliquotatotal / 100 ) - q164_valordeducao ) / $faturamento * 100 ) * ( q165_aliquotaimposto ) / 100 ) from issgsanexosfaixasimpostosvalores inner join issgscadimpostos on q160_sequencial = q165_issgscadimpostos where q165_issgsanexosfaixasimpostoslimites = q166_sequencial )
else
( select sum( case when q160_sequencial = 6 then 5 else ( ( ( ( $faturamento * q164_aliquotatotal / 100 ) - q164_valordeducao ) / $faturamento * 100 ) - 5 ) * ( q165_aliquotaimposto ) / 100 end ) from issgsanexosfaixasimpostosvalores inner join issgscadimpostos on q160_sequencial = q165_issgscadimpostos where q165_issgsanexosfaixasimpostoslimites = q166_sequencial ) end
